description: This file defines the OA_Dll_Audit class, which extends OA_Dll and provides methods for retrieving and processing audit log data, including detailed audit entries, filtering, context descriptions, and hierarchical relationships between audit events.

classes.name: OA_Dll_Audit
classes.description: A class extending OA_Dll that provides methods for retrieving, filtering, and managing audit log data, including detailed audit info, hierarchical relationships, context descriptions, and action names.

methods.name: getAuditDetail
methods.description: Retrieves detailed audit data for a specific audit ID, including context description, children, and action name.

methods.name: getAuditLog
methods.description: Fetches a list of audit events filtered by various parameters such as account, date range, advertiser, publisher, and order.

methods.name: getContextDescription
methods.description: Returns a human-readable description for a given table name, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: getActionName
methods.description: Returns the action name string based on the action ID, using a match expression.

methods.name: getParentContextData
methods.description: Sets parent context type and ID based on the audit event's context.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Retrieves child audit events for a given audit ID and context.

methods.name: hasChildren
methods.description: Checks if a specific audit event has child events.

methods.name: _removeParentContextId
methods.description: Removes parent context identifiers from an audit array based on its context type.

methods.name: getAuditLogForAuditWidget
methods.description: Fetches recent audit logs for display in an audit widget, with filtering and date restrictions.
